name: Pitchbook QC

inputs.name: Which pages carry the key numbers

steps.title: Cross-foot the numbers
steps.detail: The same metric must match everywhere it appears. Valuation page vs summary vs football field.

steps.title: Check the footnotes
steps.detail: Every chart sourced and dated. "Source: Company filings" with no date is not a source.

steps.title: Enforce the style
steps.detail: Fonts, decimals, currency conventions, color palette, alignment — consistency reads as competence.

steps.title: Read for story
steps.detail: Does each page earn its place and lead to the next? Orphan pages get cut or moved.

steps.title: Final mechanical pass
steps.detail: Page numbers, TOC accuracy, no draft watermarks, client name correct EVERYWHERE (the classic).

steps.title: Delegate 1
steps.detail: Extracting every numeric instance for cross-page consistency checks

steps.title: Delegate 3
steps.detail: Checking formatting consistency against style rules

sections.name: QC issue list by page
sections.detail: The final-pass quality control every book needs: numbers consistent across pages, footnotes complete, formatting to house style, sources current, and the story coherent page to page. The checks that save analysts from 2am reprints.

outputs.sourcePolicy: Every figure cites the page or filing it was read from; nothing is stated without a source.

verification.description: Flagged inconsistencies are real (rounding conventions differ by page legitimately)
Client/company name search performed on the final file

humanCheckpoints: Which issues block sending vs get fixed in the next turn
Whether the storyline works — no tool judges that

display.jobToBeDone: Catch the errors in a pitchbook before it leaves the building.
